#Assignment 2: Max Warriner

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)


# # Question 1 ------------------------------------------------------------


setwd("C:/Users/12697/Documents/Multivariate Data Analysis/Assignment 2")
file= 'Digits.Rdata'
load(file)

# Part a

digits_mean_cov <- function(digits){
  
  p=28*28 ; X= array(0,c(1000, p, 10))
  
  for(k in 0:9){ 
    for(i in 1:1000){
      X[i, , k+1]=digits[, , i,k+1] 
    } 
  }
  
  mean <- array(0, dim = c(10, p))
  
  # Mean Digit
  for(k in 1:10) { 
    mean[k, ] = apply(X[, , k] , 2 , mean)
  }
  
  # Pooled Within-group Covariance
  cov = array(0,c(28*28, 28*28))
  for(k in 0:9){ 
    cov_k = cov(X[,, k+1]) ; cov = cov + cov_k /10
  }
  
  return(list(mean, cov, X))
  
}

res <- digits_mean_cov(digits)

(cov <- res[[2]])

X <- res[[3]]


# Part b

p=28*28

o=eigen(cov) ; G=o$vectors; Lam=o$values
# Reasonable way to fix signs of loading vector {signs are arbitrary}
for(j in 1:p) { # j=2
  G[,j]=sign(G[which.max(abs(G[,j])),j])* G[,j]}


library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

gg_dat <- tibble(eigenv = 1:784, 
                 variance_explained = Lam/sum(Lam), 
                 cumulative_variance = cumsum(Lam/sum(Lam)))

ind_plot <- ggplot(data = gg_dat, aes(x = eigenv)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = variance_explained)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  theme_bw() + 
  xlab('Eigenvector') + 
  ylab('') + 
  ggtitle('Variance Explained')

cumul_plot <- ggplot(data = gg_dat, aes(x = eigenv, y = cumulative_variance)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  theme_bw() + 
  xlab('Eigenvector') + 
  ylab('') + 
  ggtitle('Cumulative Variance Explained')

(combined <- ind_plot / cumul_plot)

# Number of PCs required to explain 90% of variance
vexpl <- cumsum(Lam / sum(Lam))
kk=ceiling(approx(vexpl,1:p,xout=.99)$y)
print(round(c(kk)))


# Part c

digit_var_dat <- tibble(digit = 0:9)

Z <- array(0, dim = c(kk, 1000, 10))

  for (k in 1:10) {
    Z <- X[, , k] %*% G[, 1:kk]
    
    digit_var_dat$var_explained[k] <- sum(apply(Z, 2, var)) / sum(apply(X[, , k], 2, var))
  }

(digit_var_explained <- ggplot(data = digit_var_dat, aes(x = digit, y = var_explained*100)) + 
  geom_col() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 99, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  annotate("text", x = 4.5, y = 99.05,             
           label = "Whole Data Variance Cut-Off", 
           hjust = 1, color = "red", size = 2.5) +
  theme_bw() + 
  xlab("Digit") + 
  ylab("Variance Explained (%)") + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:9) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(98, 100)))

setwd("C:/Users/12697/Documents/Multivariate Data Analysis/Assignment 2")
file= 'Digits.Rdata'
load(file)

library(stats)

# part a

redigits <- array(0, dim = c(1000, 28*28, 10))
for (i in 1:10){
  redigits[, , i] <- c(digits[, , , i])
}

clusts <- list()

for (i in 1:10){
  clust_i <- hclust(dist(redigits[, , i]), method = 'ward.D')
  clusts[[i]] <- cutree(clust_i, k = 15)
}

cluster_means <- array(0, dim = c(784, 15, 10))
for (i in 1:10){
  for (j in 1:15){
    cluster_means[, j, i] <- apply(redigits[clusts[[i]] == j, , i], 2, mean)
  }
}

cluster_means

# part b

rss <- array(0, dim = c(10000, 10))

digits_stacked <- array(0, dim = c(10000, 28*28))
for (i in 1:10){
  digits_stacked[((i-1)*1000+1):(i*1000),] <- digits[, , , i]
}

for (i in 1:10000){
  for (j in 1:10){
    rss[i, j] <- sum((lm(digits_stacked[i,] ~ cluster_means[, , j])$residuals)^2)
  }
}

#part b

dev.off()
par(mfrow = c(3, 4), mar = rep(2, 4))

for(i in 1:10){
  boxplot(rss[((i-1)*1000+1):(i*1000), ], 
          xaxt = 'n')

}

#part c

d_opt <- rep(NA, 10000)

for (i in 1:10000){
  image_rss <- rss[i,]
  d_opt[i] = which.min(image_rss)-1
}

accuracy_test <- ifelse(d_opt == rep(0:9, each = 1000), 1, 0)
accuracy_test_digit <- array(accuracy_test, dim = c(1000, 10))
accuracy_test_digit <- apply(accuracy_test_digit, 2, mean)

barplot((1-accuracy_test_digit)*100, names.arg = 0:9, main = "Misclassification Rate (%)")



# # Question 3 ------------------------------------------------------------

setwd("C:/Users/12697/Documents/Multivariate Data Analysis/Assignment 2")

xx= read.table('table2.dat')

X = xx[,3:24] ; p=ncol(X) ; n=nrow(X)

# Part a

# deviations of data from median

meds = apply(X,2,median) ; mads=apply(X,2,mad)

Xd = scale(X,center=meds,scale=mads)
abdev = apply(abs(Xd),1,mean) ; summary(abdev)
qcut=quantile(abdev,p=.99)
# Trim outlying data
Xdc = Xd[abdev<qcut,]
table(xx$V25, abdev>qcut)


# Part b-i

y <- xx$V25[abdev<qcut]


library(MASS)
oo=lda(y~Xdc) ; V=oo$scaling

dev.off()
par(mfrow = c(4, 3),mar=rep(2,4))
matplot(V[, 1:4], type = "l")
title("Loadings")


fstats <- rep(NA, 10)

for (i in 1:10){
  ld <- Xdc %*% V[, i]
  fstats[i] <- summary(aov(ld ~ y))[[1]][1, 4]
}

plot(1:10, fstats, main = "F-Tests")

for (i in 1:10){
  
  ld <- Xdc %*% V[, i]
  boxplot(ld ~ y, outline = F)
  title(i)
  
}



# part b-ii

dev.off()
par(mfrow = c(3, 3),mar=rep(3,4))

lds <- Xdc %*% V

n = 5

for (i in 1:(n-1)){
  for (j in (i+1):n){
    
    if(i == j){
      next
    }
    
    if(i == 4 && j == 5){
      break
    }
  
  means <- tibble(group = unique(y), 
                  x = rep(NA, 11), 
                  y = rep(NA, 11))
  
  for (g in 1:11){
    means$x[g] <- {
      pts <- cbind(lds[y == unique(y)[g], i], lds[y == unique(y)[g], j])
      cx <- mean(pts[,1]); cy <- mean(pts[,2])
      dists <- sqrt((pts[,1]-cx)^2 + (pts[,2]-cy)^2)
      keep <- dists <= sort(dists, decreasing=TRUE)[21]
      mean(pts[keep, 1])
    }
    means$y[g] <- mean(pts[keep, 2])
  }
  
  plot(lds[,i], lds[, j], main = paste0("Discriminant ", i, " vs. ", j), xlab = paste0(i), ylab = paste0(j))
  text(means$x, means$y, labels = means$group, col = 1:11)
  
  }
}



# Part c
library(MASS)

cvl = lda(y~Xdc, CV = T) ; cv_ls = cvl$scaling
cvq = qda(y~Xdc, CV = T) ; cv_qs = cvq$scaling

library(caret)
lda_conf <- confusionMatrix(factor(cvl$class), factor(y))
qda_conf <- confusionMatrix(factor(cvq$class), factor(y))

# Misclassification by Star Type
round(1 - diag(lda_conf$table) / colSums(lda_conf$table), 3)*100 #LDA
round(1 - diag(qda_conf$table) / colSums(qda_conf$table), 3)*100 #QDA

#Overall Misclassification
round(1 - sum(diag(lda_conf$table)) / sum(lda_conf$table), 3)*100 #LDA
round(1 - sum(diag(qda_conf$table)) / sum(qda_conf$table), 3)*100 #QDA

#Correlation between sample size and misclassification rate
cor(1 - diag(lda_conf$table) / colSums(lda_conf$table), table(factor(y))) #LDA
cor(1 - diag(qda_conf$table) / colSums(qda_conf$table), table(factor(y))) #QDA
